messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: geom_errorbarh
parts:
Dear group members,

I am trying to make a plot with unique values (not a data frame) but it doesn't work with geom_errorbarh.  What I am doing wrong?

> p2 <- ggplot()
> p2 + geom_errorbarh(aes(x=2, xmax=3, xmin=1))
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'y' not found
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In min(x, na.rm = na.rm) :
  no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf
2: In max(x, na.rm = na.rm) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
3: In min(diff(sort(x))) : no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf

Best,

Manuel

--

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: geom_errorbarh
parts:
If you add a value for y to that aes call, it works. This makes
intuitive sense (how could such an error bar be plotted without a y
position?), even though the geom_errorbarh help page says that y isn't
required.

Ben
